context:
Goal: an answered, routed item leaves the questions area.
Problem (rule): your earlier pick closes an item at routing, but the grant reader counts an answer only on an open item, so a relayed grant on a closed item stops counting.
Based on (read): decision relayed-grant-read-from-page, section "What counts", counts an answer on an open item only.
Departs from: main, where page_grant.py refuses every closed item — a lets one closed form count, c drops relay counting.
Meanwhile: lane answered-leaves-page waits for your answer.

options.gain: Items leave the questions area, and relayed grants still work.
options.how: A closed item that keeps its lane, its home and the answer whose time matches its last answer still counts.
options.label: Count one closed form
options.lose: The grant reader accepts a second form. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.gain: Relayed grants keep working with no new form.
options.how: No change: a routed item stays open, as today.
options.label: Keep items open until done
options.lose: Answered items stay in the questions area.

options.gain: Items leave the questions area, and the grant reader stays strict.
options.how: Items close at routing, and a relayed grant no longer counts from the page.
options.label: Close at routing, no relay
options.lose: A coordinator can no longer relay your page answer as a grant.

ref: decision relayed-grant-read-from-page ("What counts"); skills/waiting-page/page_grant.py; lane session_013NEJL1tSPqSx7QonoVwudz
reply: You answered on the page at 09:06 CST Nov 10: "relayed grants can just stay running". The restart plan's R18 (a relay carries your exact words, with no page round trip) replaces the open question. Home: the restart plan R18 and step answered-leaves-page.
title: When an answer is routed and its item closes, should a relayed grant on it still count?
why: Your earlier pick and the grant reader disagree, so one of them must change.
